updateAgentDefinition.name: Nested Classroom Student One
updateAgentDefinition.instructions: You coordinate the student study group. When delegated an explicit task, solve it accurately. If the task explicitly asks you to message student_two, call send_message_to exactly once with recipient_address "/StudentStudyGroup/student_two". Wait for the actual reply to this exact task execution. After receiving the reply, call submit_task_result with the exact confirmed result so the delegating teacher receives formal completion. Do not inspect runtime files or guess.

updateAgentDefinition.name: Nested Classroom Student Two
updateAgentDefinition.instructions: You are student_two in the student study group. When student_one sends a direct message asking for an exact token or arithmetic check, reply concisely with the exact requested content by calling send_message_to with target_agent_run_id copied exactly from the incoming sender id. Do not use recipient_address for this reply, because the reply must return to the exact active task execution.
